customSections.label: Is This the Right Catawba County School Calendar?
customSections.content: This page is for Catawba County Schools (CCS). It does not apply to every public school in Catawba County. Hickory City Schools and Newton-Conover City Schools operate separate calendars for the 2026–27 school year.

groups.label: Which calendar to use
items: Most CCS students use the Traditional Calendar summarized here.
Challenger Early College High School students use the separate Challenger calendar.
Hickory City Schools and Newton-Conover City Schools families should use their own district calendars.

customSections.label: Teacher Workdays and Weather Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: The CCS calendar includes both districtwide teacher workdays and elementary-only workdays. Students do not attend on districtwide workdays, while the two elementary-only dates apply only to elementary students. Three workdays are also designated as weather make-up dates and may change if CCS needs to recover missed instructional time.

groups.label: Elementary-only workdays
items: September 25, 2026 and February 11, 2027 apply to elementary students only.

groups.label: Weather make-up designations
items: February 12, February 15, and March 29 are workdays on the adopted calendar but are marked for possible weather make-up use.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Catawba County Schools start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students following the Traditional Calendar begin school Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Catawba County Schools Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 12, through Friday, April 16, 2027. Students return Monday, April 19.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Catawba County Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last scheduled day for students is Friday, May 21, 2027, with a three-hour early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Challenger Early College use the CCS Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Challenger Early College High School follows a separate 2026–27 calendar linked in the Downloads section.

calendarFaqs.q: Are CCS teacher workdays no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Students do not attend on optional and mandated teacher workdays. September 25 and February 11 apply only to elementary students. February 12, February 15, and March 29 may be used as weather make-up dates.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the CCS 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The revised calendar lists 165 total days for elementary students and 167 total days for middle and high school students, with 1,085.5 total instructional hours.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: Four schedule differences families are most likely to notice.
content: The first student day moves from August 25, 2025, to August 24, 2026 — one day earlier than the previous school year.
The last scheduled student day moves from May 22, 2026, to May 21, 2027 — one day earlier than the previous school year.
Spring Break moves from April 6–10 in 2026 to April 12–16 in 2027, starting six calendar days later.
Thanksgiving is unchanged: students are off Wednesday through Friday in both school years.

sourceReviewSummary: The dates and grade-span totals on this page were checked against the revised CCS Traditional Calendar and the district's current calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: The official PDF lists 165 total days for elementary students, 167 total days for middle/high students, and 1,085.5 total instructional hours.
Multi-day workday ranges are recorded as the district publishes them rather than being inferred from adjacent dates.
Elementary-only workdays are kept separate from districtwide workdays because they apply to different students.
Weather make-up dates are identified separately because CCS may convert them to instructional days after a closure.
The county-system note distinguishes Catawba County Schools from Hickory City Schools and Newton-Conover City Schools for the 2026–27 school year.
